_comment: Render-scene exemptions for this Uplink, read by `uplink-tools docs --check`. `sceneDebt` is SHRINK-ONLY: an entry is removed by giving its augment a scene, in the same commit. The entry here is a live-video augment gated on `requires: "kerbcast"`, so a scene needs the harness to stand up that data source; that is work, not an impossibility, which is why it is debt rather than `unrenderable`.
